audit_name: source-faithful champion REPLAY supported-interface cold audit

existing_stress.exclusion_reason: Recovered native.predict assumes every perturbation is in the readout column; unsupported nonlocal cases are not in-scope scientific failures.

cold_design.coverage_limitation: All eight eligible columns are covered at each beta. The other four have only four visible spins, so six-visible-spin queries cannot cover all twelve columns without changing the interface.
cold_design.coherent_rule: Choose two readout sites without replacement, a fair sign, and amplitude 0.5 for even eligible-column position or 1.0 for odd position. Both fields have the same sign.
cold_design.balanced_rule: Choose four readout sites without replacement, independently shuffle exactly two +1 and two -1 amplitudes.
cold_design.cross_beta_rule: The same readout and local perturbation patterns are used at every beta to isolate cooling sensitivity.
cold_design.design_inputs: Only public topology/mask and the preregistered seed; no labels or fitted predictions are used for query design.

models.posterior_replay: Use unchanged recovered NativeLikelihood.predict on every one of the four frozen chains' 2400 theta draws; average all 9600 predictive distributions exactly as the recovered final summarize.py. No thinning, refitting, or parameter-mean substitution.
models.best_weakfit: Use the already-frozen public_data_portfolio/latent_fit_weak/fitted_parameters.npz with public edge signs and exact public transfer helper.

label_policy: Write queries and a hash-bearing QUERIES_FROZEN.json before opening evaluator/hidden/model.npz. Freeze all predictions before computing new exact labels. Old supported stress labels may be loaded only in the final scoring phase.
validation: Verify recovered science source and public input hashes before and after audit.
Recompute original 24 public predictions from all draws; compare to frozen replay output, not claim bitwise archived champion identity.
Compare native local reweighting with generic exact transfer on fixed posterior draws at beta 4 and 10.
Check every new true probability vector against an independent dense 256x256 transfer implementation.
Check every new true label by global spin-flip symmetry with reversed fields/readout states.
Require finite, strictly positive, normalized probability vectors; load NPZ without pickle.
score_reporting: Report supported old 60 and new cold 96 separately, and cold per-beta/per-family summaries. Per-query KL > 0.02 is diagnostic, not an original single-query gate. Do not select, revise, or refit after scores.
uncertainty_diagnostics: For every query, posterior-draw TV to posterior mean (median and 95th percentile), mean KL(draw||posterior mean), maximum per-chain mean TV, and maximum outcome probability 95-percent interval width.
After labels, per-query fraction of true outcome probabilities inside marginal 95-percent posterior intervals, and cold expected readout magnetization interval coverage.

Posterior spread is conditional on the assumed model, prior, data and approximate MCMC. It is not a proof of irreducible uncertainty, calibrated coverage, or failure of every algorithm. Chain agreement is not proof of global mixing. No new fit or score-driven calibration is allowed.
